notes.title: Bug Fix : Visit
notes.notes:
Due to an oversight, Visit's boss battle had much more health than designed.
Health was reduced from 15000 to 5000.

notes.title: Endline Demo Release + Gameplay Trailer
notes.notes:
Big news coming for Endline today.

First is the release of the first gameplay trailer, showcasing a brand new level titled “The Ant and the Spider”.  A tease of what you can expect from the full game coming up in a few weeks.

[previewyoutube=jSUkCevn9BE;full][/previewyoutube]

Second is the demo release. Everybody can get a good sample for what the game has to offer with a choice of 2 playable ships and 3 stages.

The game demo is available for both Windows and Linux users.
Enjoy
